bands.label: Left Brain Dominant
bands.text: You are Left Brain Dominant! You tend to be logical, analytical, and detail-oriented. You excel at tasks involving language, mathematics, and sequential thinking. You prefer structure, planning, and working with facts and data.

bands.label: Right Brain Dominant
bands.text: You are Right Brain Dominant! You tend to be creative, intuitive, and big-picture oriented. You excel at tasks involving art, music, spatial awareness, and imagination. You prefer flexibility, spontaneity, and visual or hands-on learning.

bands.label: Balanced Brain
bands.text: You have a Balanced Brain! You use both hemispheres fairly equally, giving you a blend of analytical and creative abilities. You can adapt your thinking style to different situations, combining logic with intuition effectively.
